sources.title: TransCoder Model | facebookresearch/CodeGen | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: TransCoder follows a sequence-to-sequence architecture based on the Transformer model with encoder and decoder components. Unlike monolingual models that only use an encoder, TransCoder uses a complete encoder-decoder architecture to translate from one programming language to another.
